end.summary:
Defined food miles as the full distance from farm to home or shop.
Correctly added distances: 30 + 12 = 42 km and 220 + 90 = 310 km.
Compared distance travelled using examples from Himachal, Chennai, Assam and Jaipur.
Explained effects including fuel use, pollution, freshness, cold storage and cost.
Suggested local seasonal foods, nearby farms or mills, and a school garden; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised defining food miles, adding route distances, comparing food journeys, and discussing fuel, pollution, freshness, storage and cost. Rohan used the method of starting at the farm and adding each part of the journey, and suggested practical ways to reduce food miles. They also recognised that local seasonal food is helpful, but food cannot always be local when it is out of season. At home, ask them to compare two foods by tracing where each came from and adding the distances.

Mai mein paas ki mandi ke aam aur December mein door se aaye aam mein kaunse mausami hain, aur paas se aane ka kya fayda ho sakta hai?
मई वाले आम तो पास के होंगे न, और मौसमी भी... मतलब दिसंबर वाले दूर से आते हैं, वो मौसमी नहीं। फ़ायदा... फ़ायदा ये कि पास वाले ताज़ा मिलते हैं और सस्ते भी।

Mai wale paas ke aam mausami hain aur taaza mil sakte hain. Door se aaye aam ko laane mein zyada indhan lag sakta hai, jisse pradushan badhta hai; saste hona zaroori nahi. Ab chai ke packet par Assam likha hai, aur aap Jaipur mein hain. Us chai ke khaane ki safar-doori kam hogi ya zyada, aur kyon?
ज़्यादा हैं food miles, क्योंकि असम तो बहुत दूर है जयपुर से।

Bilkul, Assam se Jaipur tak chai ka safar lamba hai, isliye khaane ki safar-doori zyada hai. Ab ek mushkil misaal: aloo Punjab mein uge, Haryana tak 220 kilometer gaye, phir dukaan tak 90 kilometer. Kul safar-doori kaise nikaalenge?

Bilkul, 220 aur 90 jodkar kul safar 310 kilometer hua. Ab do teer sochiye: ek Himachal se Chennai tak seb ka, doosra Chennai ke paas ke khet se kele ka. Kaunsa teer lamba hoga, aur uski lambai kya batayegi?
हिमाचल से चेन्नई वाला तीर लंबा होगा, क्योंकि हिमाचल बहुत दूर है। और तीर की लंबाई food miles दिखाती है न, मतलब खाना कितना चला।
Aapne Himachal wala teer lamba bataya aur use khaane ke safar se joda. Ab school ke dopahar ke khaane ki sochiye. Uski safar-doori kam karne ke teen tareeke kya ho sakte hain?
पास के खेत से सब्ज़ी लेना... स्कूल में ही थोड़ी बगिया लगा दो... और हाँ, चावल-दाल पास की मिल से लो।

Aapne paas ke khet, school ki bagiya aur paas ki mill se lene ke tareeke bataye. Ab sardiyon mein Jaipur ke school ko phal bhi dena hai. Card ke dono tareekon mein se kaunsa zyada samajhdari wala hai, aur kyon?
वो 'जब मिले पास का सीजनल फल' वाला ठीक है। साल भर सिर्फ पास वाला देंगे तो दिसंबर में आम कहाँ से लाओगे? सीजन नहीं है।

Aapne sahi socha ki December mein paas ke aam milna mushkil hai. Isliye phal chunte waqt mausam ki seema dekhni padti hai. Agar phal bahut door se aaye, to uske safar mein indhan aur hawa par kya asar pad sakta hai?
